_about: A made-up example showing the exact structure of skill_run/config.json, which the skill writes at the end of intake. The books and files are fictional. Relative paths are resolved against the project folder (the folder that contains skill_run/). Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored.
research_purpose: investigating the cognitive demands of practice questions and investigations in two Grade 6 mathematics textbooks
subject: Mathematics

item_types.name: Question
item_types.definition: any main numbered item in the section; sub-parts belong to their parent item

item_types.name: Investigation
item_types.definition: any separately listed task in the section, with all its steps

books.name: Number Journeys
books._note: File names are filled in as each stage creates them.

framework.name: Webb's Depth of Knowledge
framework._coding_mode_options: A = multi-label 0/1 (several categories per item); B = exactly one category per item
framework._category_groups_note: Optional. Use {} for no groups. In Path A, an item belongs to a group if any of the group's categories is 1.
framework._level_order_note: Path B only, optional: categories from lower to higher demand. Use [] if unordered.

_exclusions_note: Item_IDs excluded from all analysis; keep in sync with skill_run/exclusions.md.
